report.summary: tests/test_extension_manifest.py: Implements manifest-consistency checks for the VS Code extension, verifying that package.json commands, views, activation events, menus, configuration properties, main entry, and engine version are consistent with extension.js source using real parsers and regexes anchored to specific API calls.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_extension_manifest.py|the regexes are anchored to exact VS Code API call shape, not prose, making them safer than matching in comments
